title: Origami Paper Crane
description: Learn the traditional Japanese art of paper folding with this classic crane project.
instructions: Fold the paper in half diagonally to form a triangle.
Fold in half again to make a smaller triangle.
Open the flap and squash fold into a square.
Repeat on the other side.
Fold the edges towards the center to create a diamond shape.

title: Boho Macrame Wall Hanging
description: Create a beautiful textured wall hanging using basic macrame knots.
instructions: Attach cords to the dowel using lark's head knots.
Create a row of square knots across the top.
Incorporate half-hitch knots for diagonal patterns.
Add fringe at the bottom and trim to desired shape.
Brush out the fringe for a soft look.
notes: Need to buy more white cord.

title: Watercolor Sunset Painting
description: A relaxing project to explore color blending and gradients.
instructions: Wet the paper lightly with clean water.
Apply yellow paint at the horizon line.
Blend in orange and then red as you move upwards.
Add dark purple or blue at the very top for depth.
Paint a simple silhouette of trees or mountains once dry.

title: Personalized Mug
description: Customized mugs for your loved ones using porcelain markers.
instructions: Clean the mug thoroughly with alcohol.
Draw your design using porcelain markers.
Let it dry for 24 hours.
Bake in the oven according to marker instructions to set the ink.
Let it cool completely before using.
